initialExam.title: IBPS RRB PO (Officer Scale I) 2026
initialExam.description: Regional Rural Banks Officer Scale I exam for recruitment as officers in regional rural banks across India. Notification expected September 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Reasoning (40Q), Quantitative (40Q). Mains: Reasoning (40Q), Quant (40Q), GK/Financial Awareness (40Q), English/Hindi (40Q), Computer Knowledge (40Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 80 questions, 80 marks, 45 min. Mains: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Interview.
initialExam.jobRole: Officer Scale I in Regional Rural Banks
initialExam.careerGrowth: Officer Scale I → Scale II → Scale III → Chairman.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ibps.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit

salaryRange.description: Scale I officer pay (12th Bipartite Settlement)
